title: Do not accept
excerpt: AI companies are deciding on our future. See what you’re being signed up for.
content_html:
Do not accept

We think that everyone should be very worried about the trajectory of AI development. We’ve written this like a Terms & Conditions agreement because, in a sense, that’s what’s happening. A small number of private tech companies are making the biggest decisions about your future, and they’re acting as if they already have your buy-in.Do Not Accept is a campaign by the Machine Intelligence Research Institute (MIRI), the world’s oldest AI safety research organization. The campaign was created in collaboration with creative agency Don’t Panic and production company ProdCo. The campaign film was directed by Alex Takács.Press inquiriesmedia@donotaccept.ai

AI companies are deciding our future.

Here’s what they’ve signed you up for:

Tell AI companies: we do not accept these terms.

people do not accept.

do not accept the terms.
